Uniswap ($UNI) activated the VolatilePair Hook on Ethereum mainnet on October 14, with $ETH/$USDC as its inaugural trading pair. Designed for volatile trading pairs, the Hook recalculates separate dynamic fees for buys and sells on every swap based on recent price movements, instead of applying the same fee rate to both.

Key features also include a temporary surcharge on swaps when the pool’s quoted price lags behind external markets and arbitrage trades push the price back into line. This is intended to keep more value in the pool and reduce the arbitrage losses faced by liquidity providers under static fee rates. Uniswap says that trading volume for volatile pairs exceeded $500 billion in 2026; StablePair Hook, launched in September for stablecoin pairs, recorded around $3.1 billion in volume within four weeks. Pool parameters and fee logic can be upgraded through Uniswap governance. Liquidity providers can migrate their positions to new pools, and the swap feature is available on the Uniswap website and in its wallet.

#UNI #ETH #DeFi  This does not constitute investment advice

content:
Uniswap（$UNI）于10月14日在以太坊主网启用 VolatilePair Hook，首发交易对为 $ETH/$USDC。该 Hook 面向波动性交易对：按近期价格走势，在每次兑换时分别重算买入与卖出两套动态手续费，而不再沿用买卖同一费率。

机制要点还包括：当池内报价落后于外部盘口、套利盘推动价格回正时，相关兑换需额外支付临时附加费，以便把更多价值留在池内、减轻静态费率下流动性提供者被套利吃差的情况。Uniswap 称 2026 年波动性交易对成交已超 5000 亿美元；此前 9 月上线的 StablePair Hook（稳定币对）四周内成交约 31 亿美元。池参数与费率逻辑可通过 Uniswap 治理升级，流动性提供方可迁移仓位至新池，兑换端可在 Uniswap 网页与钱包使用。

ETH 剧本更简单：2371 是日线买点，2313 是 24 小时低点。2371 守不住，这两个数字迟早合并成一个。

一句话总结：数据偏空，反弹是修正，不是反转。80655 上方 BTC 还算体面；失守了，就别再念逢跌吸纳的经。市场教育投资者的方式，从来都是先教育不服的。

The Last Night of 50x Leverage

At 3:17 a.m., Lin Yuan stared at the ETH candlestick chart on his phone, his fingers trembling slightly.

Ethereum had been sliding steadily from $2,500 since two days ago, and now it had fallen to $2,365. In his futures account, his 50x leveraged long position was flashing a glaring red warning. His maintenance margin ratio was down to just 3.2%.

“No way. ETH can’t possibly fall below $2,300,” he murmured. His voice sounded especially hollow in the tiny rented apartment.

Three months ago, Lin Yuan had been a “futures trading god,” posting his profits on social media. Back then, BTC had been hovering around $81,000, and he’d made 30,000 yuan going long with 20x leverage. His friends called him “Lin the God,” and he’d gotten carried away, convinced he’d cracked the code to getting rich.

Then he doubled his starting capital and increased his leverage from 20x to 50x.

Tonight’s drop had come out of nowhere. The big-name influencer in the group chat who’d been saying “ETH will bounce back to $2,500” earlier that day had gone completely silent, along with everyone else. Lin Yuan kept refreshing Binance Square. The screen was filled with liquidation screenshots and anguished posts. BLUR, on the other hand, had surged 21% against the trend, but he didn’t have any money to buy spot. His entire net worth was locked in this futures position that was about to be wiped out.

At 3:42 a.m., ETH fell to $2,358.

The instant the system alert sounded, Lin Yuan felt as if an invisible hand had clenched his heart. Liquidation notice. His 50x long position had been liquidated. His account balance went from 42,000 yuan to zero.

No—not just zero. He still owed the platform 800 yuan in funding fees.

He turned off his phone, lay on the bed, and stared at the ceiling. Outside, a truck rumbled in the distance. It sounded just like the night three months ago when he’d opened his first futures position. Back then, he’d been so excited he couldn’t sleep all night, convinced he was on the verge of financial freedom.

His phone lit up again. It was a Binance notification, sharing a trending post on Square titled “I made 20x on BLUR.”

Lin Yuan gave a bitter smile. He remembered a friend recommending BLUR to him last week, when it was barely over a cent. He’d said, “I don’t touch these little coins. I only trade ETH and BTC.” Now BLUR had climbed to $0.0129, while his ETH position had vanished into thin air.

He rolled over and buried his face in the pillow.

Forty-two thousand yuan—eight months’ worth of delivery earnings he’d saved.

He had to get up early to make deliveries tomorrow. He set his alarm for 6:20 and closed his eyes. In the darkness, the faint glow of his phone flickered on and off, just like those candlestick charts he could never go back to.

content:
五十倍杠杆的最后一夜

凌晨三点十七分，林远盯着手机屏幕上ETH的K线图，手指微微发抖。

以太坊从两天前的两千五百美元一路下滑，此刻已经跌到了两千三百六十五美元。他的合约账户里，那个五十倍做多的仓位正在发出刺眼的红色警告。维持保证金率只剩百分之三点二。

"不会的，ETH不可能跌破两千三。"他喃喃自语，声音在出租屋里显得格外空洞。

三个月前，林远还是个在朋友圈晒收益的"合约战神"。那时候BTC在八万一千美元附近震荡，他靠着二十倍杠杆做多赚了三万块。朋友们叫他林神，他飘飘然地觉得自己找到了财富密码。

然后他把本金翻了一倍，杠杆从二十倍加到了五十倍。

今晚的下跌来得毫无征兆。白天还在说"ETH要反弹到两千五"的社群大V，此刻已经全员沉默。林远刷新着币安广场，满屏都是爆仓截图和哀嚎。BLUR倒是逆势涨了百分之二十一，可他根本没钱去买现货，全部身家都锁在这个即将归零的合约里。

凌晨三点四十二分，ETH跌到了两千三百五十八美元。

系统提示音响起的那一瞬间，林远的心脏像是被一只无形的手狠狠攥住。强平通知。他的五十倍多单被清算了。账户余额从四万两千块变成了零。

不，比零更惨。他还欠着平台八百块的资金费率。

他关掉手机，躺在床上盯着天花板。窗外传来远处货车的轰鸣声，像极了三个月前他第一次开合约时听到的声音。那时候他激动得整夜睡不着，觉得自己即将财务自由。

手机又亮了。是币安的通知，推送了一条广场热帖，标题写着"我在BLUR上赚了二十倍"。

林远苦笑了一下。他想起上周朋友推荐他买BLUR，当时价格才一分钱出头。他说"这种小币不碰，我只做ETH大饼"。现在BLUR涨到了零點零一二九美元，而他的ETH仓位已经灰飞烟灭。

他翻了个身，把脸埋进枕头里。

四万两千块，是他攒了八个月的外卖钱。

明天还要早起跑单。他设好六点二十的闹钟，闭上眼睛。黑暗中，手机屏幕的微光一闪一闪，像极了那些他再也回不去的K线。

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨

很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Rolling Positions: Fortune Favors the Bold—or a Fast Track to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
“Rolling positions” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a major trend, roll it over a few times
and turn it into dozens of times your original amount. Today, let’s talk about what they don’t tell you.

【How Rolling Positions Works】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, use them as risk capital for new positions and keep opening trades,
It’s like using the market’s money to increase your leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding can be astonishing; once it stops, those unrealized gains
can go from dozens of points in profit to zero with just one or two big bearish candles.

【The Mathematical Truth】The essence of rolling positions is “getting it right repeatedly.” If each trade has a 60% win rate, the odds of winning four times in a row
are only 13%. Behind every post you see about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

translatedData.content:
ETH Falls Below $2,400 | Verify Trending Liquidation Claims | Stick to Discipline Before Buying the Dip

My stance is to stay away from catching a falling knife for now. The trending topic on Binance Square is #EthereumDropsBelow$2400, and Binance market coverage confirms that ETH has fallen below $2,400. At the time of writing, I independently checked ETH/USD on Kraken, which was around $2,359. Over the past 24 hours, it opened at about $2,419, reached a high of around $2,519, and hit a low of roughly $2,313. In other words, $2,400 is not a static level that was merely touched before the price bounced back: a fairly wide intraday range has already emerged. But Kraken’s USD quote and Binance’s USDT pair are not exactly the same trading pair, so their small price difference should not be portrayed as an arbitrage signal.

There is also a popular claim on Binance Square that “ETH accounts for 60% of crypto liquidations.” I haven’t found first-hand details that would let me consistently verify the data platform, exchange coverage, and time window, so I won’t present that 60% figure as confirmed fact. What can be confirmed is that the price fell below the level; that alone does not prove the decline was entirely caused by long liquidations. If leveraged positions are concentrated around a round-number level, a break below it could trigger more stop-losses and forced liquidations, adding to short-term selling pressure. If spot demand is insufficient, a rebound may then run into selling from underwater holders near the former support. This is a theoretical explanation of how the mechanism works, not a measured conclusion about this round of trading.

Separately, Binance announced maintenance of its Ethereum network wallet, affecting deposits and withdrawals on that network, and explicitly stated that trading would not be affected. I won’t misrepresent routine maintenance as an Ethereum network outage or an exchange security incident, nor use it to explain the current drop. U.S. spot ETH funds recorded net outflows on October 14, but that is a flow figure from the previous trading day; it does not mean that an equivalent amount of spot selling is occurring right now. $106 million liquidated in one hour, nearly 60% of the total: $ETH, not BTC, is the star of this downturn

In the 24 hours after hotter-than-expected CPI data was released, liquidations across the crypto market totaled about $940 million, with long positions accounting for more than 90%. And the biggest casualty this time wasn’t $BTC—it was $ETH.

The numbers don’t lie. $ETH 10 fell nearly 6% on October 15, hitting a low of around $2,350 and breaking below the $2,400 support level that had held for two months. CryptoQuant analyst Darkfost noted that within an hour of the CPI release, $106 million in Binance $ETH long positions were liquidated—the largest single-hour total in nearly six months. Across all platforms over 24 hours, $ETH liquidations totaled about $283 million, compared with about $196 million for $BTC. $ETH accounted for nearly 60% of the combined liquidations for the two coins, putting it at the top of the trending charts.

Why did $ETH fall harder than $BTC? Three factors compounded the drop. First, higher leverage: traders bet on $ETH for its greater upside potential, so leverage tends to be higher. Second, thinner order books: once key levels broke, buy-side depth wasn’t enough to absorb the selling pressure. Third, a more complex ecosystem: spot markets, staking, and layers of DeFi collateral are interconnected. A single shock can spread across multiple collateral layers and trigger a cascade of liquidations: falling prices trigger liquidations, which push prices lower, completing a negative feedback loop.

Institutions are sitting on the sidelines, too: preliminary data for October 14 shows continued net outflows from spot Ethereum ETFs. There’s no one stepping in to catch the falling knife—only people crunching the numbers. The RSI has dropped to around 34, and $2,300 is the next level in focus.

The macroeconomic guillotine hasn’t lifted yet. Tonight at 20:30 Beijing time, PPI, retail sales, and initial jobless claims are all due, with the October 27–28 FOMC meeting just around the corner. September CPI came in at 3.7% year over year, with core CPI up 0.3% month over month, already putting “rate hikes” back on the table. After losing $2,400, will $ETH stabilize at $2,300, or follow the macro mood lower? Tonight’s data will be the next test.

I only learned this lesson the hard way myself.
EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine) is the virtual machine that executes Ethereum smart contracts. Every node executes the same contract code according to the same rules.
The EVM charges Gas for each instruction. Once a transaction runs out of Gas, it is halted and its state changes are reverted, so an infinite loop can't get stuck and hold up the entire network.
When calling a contract on Ethereum, the EVM collects Gas for each instruction it executes. Pay using $ETH . Currently 2365.5.

EVM 按每条指令计 Gas，交易带的 Gas 用完就中止并撤销状态变化，这样就不会有死循环卡住全网。

title: Ethereum Price Prediction: Why Is ETH Falling Harder Than Bitcoin?
subTitle:
Hotter US inflation has shaken crypto markets, with Ethereum facing heavy liquidation pressure. Here’s why leveraged positions matter, what could happen next, and the signals ETH traders should watch.

$ETH is showing why a sharp crypto sell-off can become much more painful when leverage enters the picture. ⚠️
The latest US inflation report has put pressure on risk assets, and Ethereum has taken a harder hit than Bitcoin in recent market trading.
But there is more to this move than a red candle on the chart.
When prices fall quickly, leveraged traders can be forced out of their positions. Those forced exits can add more selling pressure, pushing prices lower and triggering further liquidations.
The big question now is whether ETH is experiencing a temporary leverage flush or whether the market is signaling a deeper loss of confidence.
Let’s look at what matters. 👇
🔥 1. Why Is Ethereum Under Pressure?
The latest US inflation report showed annual inflation rising to 3.7% in September, above economists’ expectations.
That has renewed concerns about how the Federal Reserve may respond and whether interest rates could remain higher for longer.
For crypto, the concern is straightforward: tighter financial conditions can make investors less willing to take risks.
Ethereum is not affected by macroeconomic news alone. Network activity, demand for ETH, derivatives positioning, and broader market sentiment also influence its price.
However, when uncertainty rises across financial markets, leveraged crypto positions can become especially vulnerable.
⚡ 2. What Does a Liquidation Actually Mean?
A liquidation happens when an exchange closes a leveraged position because the trader no longer has enough margin to support it.
Here is how a sell-off can accelerate:
🔻 Step 1: ETH starts falling, putting leveraged long positions under pressure.
🔻 Step 2: Some traders reach their liquidation thresholds, and their positions are automatically closed.
🔻 Step 3: Those forced closures can add selling pressure to an already weakening market.
🔻 Step 4: If the price falls further, additional leveraged positions may be liquidated.
This can create a chain reaction.
But liquidations are not proof that every seller is bearish or that ETH’s fundamentals have deteriorated. They show that leveraged positions are being closed, often during periods of rapid volatility.
That distinction matters.
📊 3. Why Could ETH Be Falling Harder Than BTC?
Recent market reporting attributed a significant share of crypto liquidation activity to Ethereum, alongside a sharper short-term price decline than Bitcoin.
Several factors may help explain the difference.
🔹 Leverage and positioning
If too many traders are positioned for prices to rise, a sudden decline can force crowded long positions to unwind.
🔹 Market liquidity
When prices move quickly, available liquidity may not be enough to absorb large orders without additional price movement.
🔹 Relative demand
Bitcoin and Ethereum do not always attract the same flows. Differences in investor demand, derivatives positioning, and market sentiment can cause them to perform differently.
🔹 The wider macro environment
When investors reduce risk, some altcoins and major crypto assets can experience sharper moves than Bitcoin.
These are possible explanations, not proof of a single cause. To determine why ETH is underperforming, traders should compare actual liquidation data, spot flows, open interest, and trading volume.
🧭 4. Three Signals ETH Traders Should Watch
📉 Signal 1: Does ETH Stabilize After the Liquidations?
A decline followed by stabilization can suggest that forced selling is easing.
But one green candle is not enough to confirm a recovery.
Look for ETH to hold an established support area, build a stronger price base, and show sustained buying rather than a brief bounce.
📈 Signal 2: What Happens to Open Interest?
Open interest measures the outstanding value of derivatives positions that remain open.
If open interest drops sharply during a decline, it may indicate that leveraged positions are being closed.
That can reduce some immediate leverage risk, but it does not automatically mean the bottom is in. Fresh selling can continue even after a large liquidation event.
💵 Signal 3: Does Spot Demand Return?
A healthier recovery would ideally be supported by genuine buying in the spot market, not just a rush of leveraged traders opening new long positions.
Watch spot trading volume, broader market sentiment, and whether ETH begins to outperform or continues to lag behind BTC.
No, single metric can tell the whole story. The combination matters.
🟢 5. Could Ethereum Recover From Here?
Yes, but the recovery case needs evidence.
The bullish scenario: Liquidation pressure fades, ETH holds important support, spot demand improves, and the broader market becomes less concerned about tighter monetary policy. Together, those developments could support a rebound.
The bearish scenario: Inflation worries persist, risk appetite weakens, ETH breaks key support, and selling pressure remains strong. That could leave ETH vulnerable to further downside.
The uncertain scenario: Liquidations slow, but buyers remain cautious. ETH may consolidate while traders wait for new economic data and clearer market direction.
A liquidation flush can remove some excessive leverage from the market, but it does not guarantee a reversal.
⚖️ 6. The Mistake Traders Should Avoid
One of the biggest mistakes during a sharp decline is assuming that an asset must bounce simply because many traders have already been liquidated.
Markets can remain weak after leverage has been reduced.
Another mistake is opening a leveraged long position simply because ETH looks cheaper than it did yesterday.
A lower price does not automatically mean better value, and leverage can magnify losses when volatility remains high.
Before making a decision, consider your risk tolerance, the possibility of further downside, and whether your thesis is supported by evidence rather than emotion.
💡 My Takeaway
Ethereum’s recent weakness highlights how macroeconomic uncertainty and leveraged positioning can combine to amplify a crypto sell-off.
The important question is not just how much ETH has fallen. It is whether forced selling is easing, whether buyers are returning, and whether the broader market environment is improving.
I would watch three things closely:
✅ ETH’s price structure around established support levels.
✅ Changes in open interest and liquidation activity.
✅ Spot demand and the direction of the wider crypto market.
A liquidation event can create volatility, but it cannot tell us on its own whether the next move will be up or down.

【Definition】What exactly is the EVM, and what does “EVM-compatible” mean?
EVM execution must be deterministic: the same input must produce the same result on every node, or the nodes won’t be able to reach consensus.
When a contract is called on Ethereum, the EVM charges Gas for each instruction it executes, paid with $ETH .

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Blowing Up
translatedData.subTitle:
You’ve read the trend correctly and want to add to your position—but how? Going all-in right away and adding to the max as soon as you’re in profit is a fast track to the liquidation list.
A frequent occurrence. The right approach is called pyramid scaling.

【Principle】Each time you add to your position, add less than the previous time. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
After confirming the pullback, add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be, keeping your average cost low so you can weather a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses. Once you lose your nerve, your entire trading plan falls apart.

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Need to Be Able to Afford Losses to Stay in the Game
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means you can lose at most 200 U on a single trade. After 10 losses in a row, you’d still have 8,000,
With an account that’s only down 20%, a few winning trades can get you back. On the other hand, if you go all-in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it to break even—mathematically, you’re pretty much finished.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size below 2%.” It’s “when this trade hits its stop-loss, the amount you lose
must not exceed 2%.” So the correct order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the distance to it → work backward to determine your position size.

Here are some things to remember about the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM):
1) The EVM is the virtual machine that executes Ethereum smart contracts. Every node executes the same contract code according to the same rules.
2) The EVM is a stack-based virtual machine. Each data unit (word) is 256 bits, and the maximum stack depth is 1024.
3) Before interacting with a contract, check on a block explorer whether its source code has been verified. Be especially cautious with contracts whose source code is not public.
When calling a contract on Ethereum, the EVM charges Gas for every instruction it executes. Pay with $ETH .

What exactly is the EVM, and what does “EVM-compatible” mean?
Every EVM opcode has a fixed Gas cost. Instructions like writing to storage are much more expensive than ordinary computations.
“EVM compatibility” lets project teams write a contract once and deploy it across multiple chains. It also means that similar contract vulnerabilities may exist on several chains at the same time.
When you call a contract on Ethereum, the EVM charges Gas for every instruction it executes, paid with $ETH .
Knowledge can help you avoid pitfalls, but it can’t replace position management.

#ETH

在以太坊上调用合约，EVM 每执行一步都按指令计 Gas，用 $ETH 支付。

In-Depth Analysis of the Ethereum Market: Technical Recovery After Oversold Conditions and Fundamental Outlook

1. Price Action Review

Ethereum experienced a sharper pullback than Bitcoin during trading on October 15. Following the bigger-than-expected U.S. CPI data, Ethereum’s price quickly fell from around $2,383 to an intraday low of $2,346. Its 24-hour decline reached approximately 4.9%, significantly underperforming Bitcoin. The price subsequently recovered to around $2,370, driven by buying interest, but the rebound was relatively limited.

The intraday candlesticks show a typical pattern of a sharp drop followed by weak consolidation over the past five periods. The first candlestick opened at $2,383, fell to a low of $2,346, and closed at $2,349. Its relatively long body and short lower shadow indicate that sellers were in control. The second candlestick rebounded slightly to $2,357, but trading volume contracted noticeably. The third candlestick climbed to $2,380 on increased volume, indicating that some dip buyers had entered the market. However, the latest two candlesticks fell back to the $2,372–$2,373 range, suggesting that the rebound lacks momentum.

2. Technical Indicator Analysis

Ethereum’s position is more precarious than Bitcoin’s in terms of moving averages. The 7-period moving average is at $2,368, the 25-period moving average at $2,420, and the 99-period moving average at $2,493. The three moving averages are bearishly aligned, and the current price is below all of them, indicating that the short-, medium-, and long-term trends are all tilted to the downside. To reverse the decline, the price would first need to reclaim the 7-day moving average at $2,368, then break through resistance at $2,420 and $2,493.

The MACD indicator shows the fast line at -29.57, the slow line at -28.73, and the histogram at -0.83. Although the MACD remains in bearish territory below the zero line, the histogram’s absolute value has been shrinking steadily, narrowing from -5.93 to -0.83. For the RSI, the 6-period RSI is 40.95, the 12-period RSI is 35.86, and the 24-period RSI is 35.76. The Bollinger Bands show an upper band at $2,463, a middle band at $2,403, and a lower band at $2,344. The current price is between the lower and middle bands, closer to the lower band. 以太坊市场深度分析：超跌之后的技术修复与基本面展望

一、价格走势回顾

以太坊在十月十五日的交易中经历了比比特币更为剧烈的回调。受美国CPI数据超预期的冲击，以太坊价格从二千三百八十三美元一线快速下跌至二千三百四十六美元的日内低点，二十四小时跌幅达到约百分之四点九，明显跑输比特币。随后价格在买盘推动下回升至二千三百七十美元附近，但反弹力度相对有限。

从分时K线来看，过去五个周期内以太坊呈现出典型的急跌后弱势整理格局。第一根K线以二千三百八十三美元开盘，最低下探至二千三百四十六美元，收盘于二千三百四十九美元，实体较长且下影线较短，显示空头力量占据主导。第二根K线小幅反弹至二千三百五十七美元，但成交量明显萎缩。第三根K线放量上攻至二千三百八十美元，显示出一定的抄底资金入场。然而最新两根K线再次回落至二千三百七十二至二千三百七十三美元区间，反弹动能有所不足。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，以太坊的形势比比特币更为严峻。七周期均线位于二千三百六十八美元，二十五周期均线位于二千四百二十美元，九十九周期均线位于二千四百九十三美元。三条均线呈空头排列，当前价格位于所有均线下方，表明短中长期趋势均偏空。价格若要扭转颓势，首先需要收复二千三百六十八美元的七日均线，然后依次突破二千四百二十美元和二千四百九十三美元的中长期压力。

以太坊本轮下跌的幅度显著大于比特币，主要原因有三方面。首先，以太坊现货ETF在十月十四日录得约一点三亿美元的资金净流出，叠加此前VanEck Lido质押ETF的赎回操作，机构层面的抛压较为集中。其次，部分长期休眠的链上地址近期将六千三百六十九枚以太坊转入交易所，增加了市场的潜在供给压力。第三，技术面上以太坊跌破了多条均线和布林带下轨，触发了部分程序化交易的止损卖单。

ETH Falls Below $2,400 | Gasoline Pushes CPI Higher, but Core Inflation Hasn’t Cooled | I’m Waiting for Confirmation, Not Chasing a Rebound

First, let’s separate facts from interpretation. The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics released September CPI data on October 14: headline inflation was up 3.7% year over year, above August’s 3.4%; month over month, it rose 0.6%, with gasoline prices up 9.1% and accounting for more than half of the monthly increase. Excluding food and energy, core CPI was up 2.6% year over year and 0.3% month over month—the same monthly increase as in August. So neither “it’s all oil prices, so we can ignore it” nor “core inflation has suddenly spiraled out of control” is what the original report says. The first overlooks the fact that core inflation didn’t ease month over month; the second describes an unchanged monthly core rate as an acceleration. The BLS released inflation data, not the Fed’s next interest-rate decision, and certainly not an explanation for ETH’s price movements.

Why should ETH traders pay attention to this? If persistent inflation leads markets to price in a higher interest-rate path, dollar liquidity and risk-asset valuations could come under pressure first. But ETH has another set of factors of its own: whether fund outflows continue and whether on-chain activity can generate real demand. Farside’s fund-by-fund data shows that U.S. spot ETH funds had combined net outflows of $129.5 million through October 14, while October 13 saw net inflows of $24.8 million. The flows went in opposite directions on those two days, so the old talking point about “ten consecutive days of outflows” shouldn’t be carried forward to the present. Nor should ETF flows be equated with spot sell orders at the same moment.

The market has reacted, but I won’t mechanically attribute every dollar of the decline to CPI. At the time of writing, ETH/USD was around $2,369 on Kraken, below the daily open of about $2,419; its 24-hour high was around $2,519 and its low around $2,313. After losing $2,500, $2,400 is the immediate level to reclaim; $2,310–$2,320 is the risk zone near the intraday low, while $2,510–$2,520 is the next confirmation zone above. These are levels to watch, not guaranteed support that will produce a rebound. My cautious view would begin to soften only if the price regains $2,400 and holds there consistently, while fund flows stop deteriorating. If it falls below $2,310 again and cannot quickly recover, we should acknowledge that downside risk is increasing.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t chase a short or buy the dip right now; I’d stay flat and wait. I’d consider testing a spot long with 2% of my total capital only if ETH closes a 4-hour candle back above $2,400 and the next candle retests that level without breaking below it. I wouldn’t use high leverage. I’d take half off at the first target of $2,450, then most of the remainder at the second target of $2,510, with a close back below $2,400 as the exit condition for any remaining position. If a 4-hour candle closes below $2,360 after entry, I’d exit with a planned stop-loss. If price breaks below $2,310 first, I’d abandon the original long setup and reassess instead of averaging down. A trading plan is conditional: if the conditions aren’t met, there’s no trade—and no profit.

Sources: Official September CPI report from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Farside’s ETH fund-by-fund flow data, and live Kraken ETH/USD market data. #CPIWatch #ETH
The views above are personal market observations only and do not constitute investment advice.

ETH跌至2400美元下方｜CPI由汽油推高但核心未降温｜我的态度是等确认，不抢反弹

先把事实与推断分开。美国劳工统计局10月14日公布的9月CPI，整体同比3.7%，高于8月的3.4%；环比0.6%，其中汽油价格环比上涨9.1%，贡献了整体月度涨幅的一半以上。剔除食品与能源的核心CPI同比2.6%，环比0.3%，而8月核心环比同样是0.3%。所以“全是油价、可以忽略”与“核心通胀突然失控”都不是原始报告的结论。前者忽略核心月率没有回落，后者又把持平的核心月率说成加速。劳工统计局公布的是通胀数据，不是美联储下一次利率决定，更不是对ETH涨跌的解释。

这件事为何值得ETH交易者盯着？如果市场因通胀粘性而上修利率路径，美元流动性和风险资产估值会先受压；但ETH还叠加自己的一层变量：基金资金是否继续撤出、链上活动能否形成真实需求。Farside逐只表截至10月14日的美国现货ETH基金合计净流出1.295亿美元，10月13日却净流入2480万美元。两天方向相反，不能把旧热词“连续十天流出”直接延伸到现在，也不能把ETF流量等同于同一时刻的现货卖单。

行情已经有反应，但我不把每一美元跌幅机械归因于CPI。写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2369美元，低于日开约2419美元；近24小时高约2519、低约2313美元。2500美元失守后，2400美元是眼前收复位，2310—2320美元是日内低点附近的风险带，2510—2520美元是更上方的确认区。这些是观察价位，不是保证会反弹的支撑。若价格重新站上2400并连续守住、同时基金流量不再恶化，我的谨慎判断才会松动；若再次跌破2310且无法迅速收回，就应承认下行风险在扩大。

如果是我自己交易，我现在不追空也不抄底，方向先保持空仓等待。只有ETH在4小时收盘重回2400美元、下一根K线回踩不破，我才考虑用总资金的2%试探现货多单，不开高杠杆；第一目标2450美元先减一半，第二目标2510美元再减余下大部分，剩余仓位以跌回2400美元为平仓条件。入场后若4小时收盘跌破2360美元，按计划止损退出；若先跌破2310美元，原多头方案直接作废，重新评估而不是补仓摊低。交易计划是条件句，未触发就没有成交，更没有盈利。

translatedData.title: Uniswap adds “dual fees” for buying and selling $ETH: arbitrageurs will have to pay extra
translatedData.subTitle:
Buying and selling $ETH can now have different fee rates. On October 14, Uniswap Labs launched the VolatilePair Hook on Ethereum mainnet, starting with $ETH/$USDC—this isn’t just a promotional page; the v4 dynamic fee hook is live.

The logic is straightforward: with static fees, external markets move first while pool quotes lag behind. The first arbitrageurs to arrive pocket the spread, and LPs foot the bill. VolatilePair recalculates fees on both sides of every swap based on recent price movements—when prices rise, buying costs more and selling costs less; when they fall, it’s the other way around. After a big move, the trade that pushes the price back also gets hit with a temporary extra fee.

EIP-712 defines a format for signing structured data. Wallets that support this standard can display each item of the content to be signed, making it much easier to understand than a string of hashes. Signatures used for logging in are generally readable text and often specify the website and purpose; be especially cautious when the signature content appears as a string of gibberish.
The risk of signing is that the blockchain only checks whether the signature is valid, not whether the signer understands what they’re signing.

Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here’s the staged profit-taking strategy I’ve been using.

【Three stages】Stage one: When it reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell a third to lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade is already risk-free, and your mindset changes instantly. Stage two: When it reaches the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell another third. Stage three: Let the rest ride with a trailing stop. If it falls below the moving average
or the previous low, exit and let your profits run.

【Why this works】Sell everything too early and you’ll kick yourself. Hold everything and you’ll often watch your gains disappear and end up back where you started.

On October 8, Thailand’s Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) issued 11 notices at once, officially finalizing the rules for domestic Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs. They take effect tomorrow (October 16). $BTC  can be included in products from day one.

Key points:
1️⃣ Passive funds must maintain an annual average net exposure to a single asset of at least 80% of net assets

Put simply, Thailand is building a channel for compliant domestic capital to get “true exposure, without leverage.” Another piece has fallen into place in Asia’s ETF puzzle.

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where Should You Place a Stop-Loss? How I Choose Between Technical Levels and Percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss takes more thought than whether you set one at all. Too close, and you’ll get stopped out every day; too far, and one loss can wipe you out.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. It’s simple and straightforward, making it suitable for beginners
and helps build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might land right in a cluster of other traders’ stops.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the market structure is invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position, place it
above resistance. The logic is—if this level breaks, that’s evidence I was wrong.
Adjust your position size based on the stop distance: if it’s wide, reduce your position size to ensure the loss on any single trade remains a set percentage of your capital.

Blockchain industry | What exactly is a blob, and why does it lower Layer 2 fees?
Blobs have their own fee market: the blob base fee automatically rises or falls depending on the gap between usage and the target, and it is also burned.
“Proto-Danksharding” is an early version of full Danksharding: it first establishes the blob transaction format and fee mechanism, with capacity to be gradually increased later.
When Layer 2 networks submit blob data to the mainnet, the blob fees are also settled in $ETH . Current price: 2374.44.
Understanding the rules helps you make clearer decisions, rather than guess market movements.

When you call a contract on Ethereum, the EVM charges gas for every instruction it executes, paid with $ETH . The current price is 2375.93.

translatedData.title: Vitalik calls an end to the zkEVM speed race: security is next
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, Vitalik singled out ZKsync’s Airbender for praise: in his view, the race for speed is over.

In a post on 10/13, the official blog said Airbender Prime proved 99% of 7,200 consecutive $ETH mainnet blocks in under 10 seconds (including witness generation) on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, with all of them taking no more than 12 seconds. It also ranks near the top of the public ETHproofs leaderboard. The team says it is “the first Ethereum prover, to our knowledge, to achieve real-time proving on a single GPU.”

Vitalik’s focus isn’t on boasting about being faster; it’s on changing the question: the top priority for zkEVMs should shift entirely to security—formally verifying that the arithmetization is equivalent to the Ethereum specifications, setting a hard cap on proof costs relative to block gas, and securing the proof system itself. The hash-based STARK + RISC-V approach also comes with a post-quantum security narrative from the official blog. The speed figures for $ZK are already impressive; in the next round, let’s see who’s willing to show their security work.

When asked, “What exactly is the EVM, and what does ‘EVM-compatible’ mean?” I usually answer: The EVM is a stack-based virtual machine. Each data unit (word) is 256 bits, and the maximum stack depth is 1024. The EVM charges gas for each instruction. When a transaction runs out of gas, it halts and rolls back state changes, so an infinite loop can’t stall the entire network.

subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

Last time, we talked about how funding rates work. Today, let's look at how to use them as a sentiment thermometer.

[State 1: Rates persistently high and positive] This means longs are crowded, with everyone borrowing to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a blow-off top, and a sharp long squeeze could happen at any moment. I'm not telling you to immediately
short immediately, but rather: at this stage, be especially cautious about chasing longs and tighten your stop-loss.

[State 2: Rates persistently negative] Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic bottoms,
because everyone who needed to get out already has, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies throughout history have started at times like this.

I. Review of Price Movements

On October 15, Ethereum also experienced sharp volatility following the release of macroeconomic data. The moving-average system is broadly bearish. The 7-day exponential moving average stands at $2,377, the 25-day EMA at $2,418, and the 99-day EMA at $2,480. 以太坊市场深度分析：宏观逆风下的技术破位与反弹契机

一、价格走势回顾

十月十五日，以太坊同样经历了宏观数据冲击下的剧烈波动。价格从二千三百五十九美元开盘，盘中最高触及二千三百八十八美元，随后受CPI数据影响快速下探至二千三百四十三美元，最终反弹至二千三百七十四美元附近。日内波动区间约四十五美元，振幅接近百分之二，显示出以太坊在当前市场环境下的高波动特征。

从均线系统来看，以太坊的处境比比特币更为严峻。当前价格已经全面跌穿七日均线（二千三百六十九美元）、二十五日均线（二千四百二十六美元）和九十九日均线（二千四百九十五美元），且三条均线之间的距离正在扩大，空头排列格局十分明显。这意味着短中长期持筹者均处于浮亏状态，市场抛压较为沉重。

二、技术指标解读

移动平均线系统全面偏空。七日指数均线位于二千三百七十七美元，二十五日指数均线位于二千四百一十八美元，九十九日指数均线位于二千四百八十美元。价格远低于所有主要均线，且均线呈加速下行态势，表明下行趋势仍在延续中。值得注意的是，七日指数均线与二十五日指数均线之间的差距约为四十美元，这一差距仍在扩大，说明短期动能与中期趋势之间的背离在加剧。

布林带指标显示，上轨位于二千四百六十九美元，中轨位于二千四百零八美元，下轨位于二千三百四十七美元。当前价格已经跌破中轨，正在向下轨靠拢。布林带开口维持较宽状态，表明波动率仍然较高。若价格触及下轨后获得支撑，有望形成技术性反弹；但若跌破下轨，则可能开启新一轮下行空间。

MACD指标方面，MACD线位于负三十点四六，信号线位于负二十八点五二，柱状图为负一点九四。虽然各项数值仍为负值，但柱状图的绝对值正在缩小，从负五点九三收窄至负一点九四，显示空头动能正在逐步减弱。若后续柱状图继续收窄并转正，将形成金叉信号，为反弹提供技术依据。

RSI指标显示，六周期RSI回升至四十二点零七，十二周期RSI为三十六点三九，二十四周期RSI为三十六点零五。此前六周期RSI一度跌至二十二点八的严重超卖区域，目前已有所修复，但仍处于偏弱区域。中长周期RSI维持在三十六附近，说明整体卖压虽有缓解但尚未实质性消退。

KDJ指标呈现温和反弹，K值升至四十五点六，D值升至四十点五，J值达到五十五点八。三线从低位开始向上拐头，短期动能正在改善。威廉指标从负七十六回升至负五十二，同样确认了超卖修复的进行中。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的市场情绪压力来自多个维度。首先，美国CPI数据超预期引发的加息预期直接冲击了风险资产市场，以太坊作为第二大加密货币自然首当其冲。ETF资金流向方面，以太坊现货ETF在十月十四日录得一点二九五亿美元的净流出，叠加交易所的净流出，机构资金的撤离对价格形成了持续压制。

链上数据方面，早期持筹者出现了一定的获利了结行为。有休眠鲸鱼将价值约一千五百九十五万美元的以太坊转入交易所，增加了短期的潜在卖压。此外，以太坊网络上的UNCX vesting合约遭受了约八点六万美元的攻击，虽然规模不大，但在市场信心脆弱的背景下，安全事件容易放大恐慌情绪。

不过，以太坊生态也传来了一些积极消息。渣打银行在阿联酋推出的直接以太坊交易服务，为传统金融机构提供了合规的入场通道。代币化美股市场在过去一年增长了七点六倍，总规模达到三十一点四亿美元，以太坊作为主要的代币化基础设施平台有望从中受益。此外，Polygon通过收购Coinme获得了美国四十八个州的支付牌照，整个以太坊生态的合规化进程正在加速推进。

从技术面综合判断，以太坊短期仍处于弱势格局，但多项指标显示超卖修复正在进行中。MACD柱状图收窄、RSI从超卖区域回升、KDJ低位金叉，这些信号共同指向短期反弹的可能性在增加。建议投资者关注二千三百四十七美元布林带下轨的支撑有效性，以及二千四百零八美元中轨的压力情况。若能在下轨获得稳固支撑并放量突破中轨，则有望开启一波技术性反弹行情。宏观面上，需密切关注美联储后续政策表态和十月CPI数据的走向，这将是决定以太坊中期趋势的关键变量。

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours and is a payment between longs and shorts
The two sides pay each other; the exchange only collects and distributes the money—it doesn’t make a profit from it.

【Mechanism】Perpetual contracts have no settlement date. So how does their price stay in line with the spot price? That’s where the funding rate comes in:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (strong bullish sentiment) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money changes hands between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

1. Mining rig shipments plunged 23% year over year in Q3 2026 (according to Bitmain’s financial report)
2. The cost of current hash rate is $2.5/TH/s, 15% higher than last year’s peak (CoinDesk statistics)

📝 Analysis
[Thesis 1: Cost pressures are the main cause] The hash-rate peak isn’t really about miners “surrendering”—electricity bills and hardware markups are pushing smaller miners out of the market. Electricity costs in some parts of the U.S. have already topped $0.4/kWh, far exceeding the expected profit range for Bitcoin mining. This is more lethal than a Fed rate hike. 💡In a nutshell: hash rate is being forced to consolidate, not voluntarily retreating.

[Thesis 2: The market hasn’t priced it in at all] BTC is currently fluctuating around 62K, but the options market puts the probability of Bitcoin reaching $45K in the next six months at 35%. $ETH  left Bitcoin in the dust today—not by rising, but by falling.

Around $972 million in positions were liquidated across the market over the past 24 hours (CoinGlass, October 15). Longs accounted for 91.7%, or about $890 million. More than 180,000 traders paid the price in this wave.

But Ethereum, not Bitcoin, topped the liquidation leaderboard: $ETH  saw about $293 million liquidated, nearly 30% of the market total and almost 1.5 times Bitcoin’s liquidation total (about $197 million).

It also fell the hardest: $ETH  was at $2,371.92, down 6.11% over 48 hours (see chart), and dipped below $2,318 intraday. Bitcoin fell only around 2.5% over the same period. Ethereum’s decline was twice as steep, yet its liquidations were even higher—the bets on Ethereum were clearly heavier than those on Bitcoin.

Put simply, what took the hit first this time wasn’t Ethereum’s fundamentals, but leverage. Only 8.3% of short positions were wiped out; longs bore the brunt.

My take: the more aggressively leveraged positions get flushed out, the more any rebound depends on whether real money is willing to come in. Right now, shorts are comfortable and longs are hurting.
